notes: Variant is a supine floor straight-leg raise. Iliopsoas and rectus abdominis are both primary because the movement combines hip flexion with anterior-core control of pelvic tilt. The Quadriceps visible role is a support role specifically for the rectus femoris component measured in both reviewed studies; the local anatomy entry is a broader quadriceps group, so the role is worded narrowly. Deep transversus abdominis was not listed because it is not mapped locally as a visible mesh.
